description: This file declares constants, data structures, enums, and function prototypes for interacting with cellular modem hardware via QMI interface, including profile management, network operations, and device info retrieval.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_init
methods.description: Initializes the QMI interface with the provided context.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_open_device
methods.description: Opens the device connection for QMI communication.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_IsModemControlInterfaceOpened
methods.description: Checks if the modem control interface is open.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_select_device_slot
methods.description: Selects the device slot for modem operations.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_sim_power_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables SIM power for a given slot.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_get_total_no_of_uicc_slots
methods.description: Retrieves total number of UICC slots.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_get_uicc_slot_info
methods.description: Gets information about a specific UICC slot.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_get_active_card_status
methods.description: Gets the status of the active SIM card.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_monitor_device_registration
methods.description: Sets up monitoring for device registration status.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_profile_operation
methods.description: Performs profile create, delete, modify, or get list operations.

methods.name: cellular_hal_qmi_start_network
methods.description: Starts network connection with specified profile.
